[A1] Countable Choice is assumed for the canonical Hilbert tensor/Fock construction and Hilbert-space adjoints ([[def-countable-choice]], [[def-qft-fock-and-test-spaces]], [[def-hilbert-space-adjoint]]).

[F5] Under Countable Choice, the canonical fermionic Fock creation and annihilation operators are bounded adjoints with norms $\|f\|$ and satisfy the CAR on the whole Fock space, using the second-variable-linear pairing $\langle f,g\rangle_2$ ([[lem-qft-fock-ccr-car]]).

[F6] The canonical Fock space is the square-summable direct sum of antisymmetric tensor sectors; its pairing is $\langle f,g\rangle_2=\langle g,f\rangle$, its vacuum is $(1,0,\ldots)$, and sector creation is $c^\dagger(f)\xi=\sqrt{n+1}A_{n+1}(f\otimes\xi)$ ([[def-qft-fock-and-test-spaces]]).

[F7] Completed Hilbert tensor products have the product pairing and dense elementary tensors; completions are identified by the unique surjective linear isometry fixing the dense algebraic tensor product ([[lem-nrqm-composites-hilbert-tensor-construction]]).

Assume the Axiom of Countable Choice ([[def-countable-choice]]). Let $H,H',K,K'$ be complex Hilbert spaces and let $S\in\mathcal B(H,H')$, $T\in\mathcal B(K,K')$ be bounded linear operators ([[def-bounded-linear-operator]]). Write $H\widehat\otimes K$ for the completion of the algebraic tensor product constructed in [[lem-nrqm-composites-hilbert-tensor-construction]], with inclusion $\kappa$.

**Given:** Complex Hilbert spaces $H,H',K,K'$; bounded operators $S\in\mathcal B(H,H')$, $T\in\mathcal B(K,K')$; in (b), composable $S':H''\to H$, $T':K''\to K$; the completions $H\widehat\otimes K$, $H'\widehat\otimes K'$ of [[lem-nrqm-composites-hilbert-tensor-construction]] with inclusions $\kappa,\kappa'$; the elementary tensors $u\otimes v$.

[F1] The construction of [[lem-nrqm-composites-hilbert-tensor-construction]] gives: the algebraic tensor product $H\odot K$ with $u\otimes v$ bilinear; a positive definite inner product with $\langle u\otimes v,u'\otimes v'\rangle=\langle u,u'\rangle_H\langle v,v'\rangle_K$; the completion $H\widehat\otimes K$ with dense inclusion $\kappa$; unique orthonormal-coordinate expansions with $\|\sum_{a,b}c_{ab}e_a\otimes f_b\|^2=\sum_{a,b}|c_{ab}|^2$ for orthonormal families $(e_a)\subseteq H$, $(f_b)\subseteq K$ spanning finite-dimensional subspaces; and $\|\kappa(u\otimes v)\|=\|u\|\,\|v\|$.

Assume the Axiom of Countable Choice ([[def-countable-choice]]). Let $H$ be a complex Hilbert space, $n\ge1$, and $H^{\otimes n}$ the $n$-fold completed tensor power ($H^{\otimes1}:=H$, $H^{\otimes(k+1)}:=H^{\otimes k}\widehat\otimes H$ as in [[lem-nrqm-composites-hilbert-tensor-construction]]). For $v_0,\dots,v_{n-1}\in H$ write $v_0\otimes\cdots\otimes v_{n-1}\in H^{\otimes n}$ for the iterated elementary tensor.

[F1] The completed tensor product construction provides: the algebraic tensor product with bilinear elementary tensors, the inner product with $\langle u\otimes v,u'\otimes v'\rangle=\langle u,u'\rangle\langle v,v'\rangle$, the dense inclusion, unique orthonormal-coordinate expansions and $\|u\otimes v\|=\|u\|\,\|v\|$ ([[lem-nrqm-composites-hilbert-tensor-construction]]).

[F2] Bounded operators $S,T$ extend uniquely to $S\otimes T$ with $\|S\otimes T\|\le\|S\|\,\|T\|$, the adjoint is $S^*\otimes T^*$, and compositions multiply; unitary factors have unitary tensor product ([[lem-nrqm-composites-bounded-tensor-maps]]).

There is a unique unital isometric $*$-homomorphism $\rho:\mathsf{CAR}(H)\to\mathcal B(K)$ with $\rho(c(f))=C(f)$. For each $x$ in the algebraic union, its inductive-limit norm equals the supremum of $\|\rho(x)\|$ over all such families on nonzero Hilbert spaces. This family is nonempty: the fermionic Fock representation $C(f)\mapsto C(f)$ of [[lem-fock-creation-annihilation-satisfy-car]] attains the norm on every finite stage.
[F4] Fock creation operators and their adjoints satisfy the stated CAR relations ([[lem-fock-creation-annihilation-satisfy-car]]).

The common finite-stage norm is well defined on this union because every inclusion is isometric. Under Countable Choice, [[thm-metric-completion-exists]] supplies a metric completion and [[thm-metric-completion-carries-a-unique-banach-space-structure]] equips it with the compatible Banach-space structure; this is the norm completion of [[def-completion-of-a-normed-space]]. Define the **CAR C*-algebra over $H$**, $\mathsf{CAR}(H)$, to be this norm completion of $\mathsf{CAR}_{\mathrm{loc}}(H)$. Addition, multiplication, scalar multiplication, and involution are the compatible finite-stage operations; submultiplicativity and isometry of the involution make them extend continuously to the completion, and the C*-identity passes to limits. The identity is nonzero because the zero-dimensional stage is $\mathbb C$ and every inclusion preserves its unit. For $f\in H$, write $c(f)$ for the image of the generator in the stage $\operatorname{span}\{f\}$; the universal inductive-limit property and its norm are proved in [[thm-general-car-has-universal-inductive-limit-norm]].

On finite sums of decomposable wedges define the creation rule $C(f)\xi=f\wedge\xi$ for $f\in H$. This rule is initially defined on a dense subspace. Its bounded extension and the CAR relations for $C(f)$ and its Hilbert-space adjoint are proved in [[lem-fock-creation-annihilation-satisfy-car]].
